{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_count = data["patient_id"].duplicated().sum()
print('Duplicate patient_id counts:', duplicate_count)

# Confirm that sample_seq varies per patient
sample_seq_stats = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique().describe()
print('Unique sample_seq counts per patient:')
print(sample_seq_stats)

# Check if any patient has more than one sample_seq
multi_sample_patients = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique().gt(1).sum()
print('Number of patients with multiple sample_seq:', multi_sample_patients)

# Deduplicate: keep row with highest sample_seq per patient
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Final number of unique patients
num_unique_patients = deduplicated_data.shape[0]
print('Number of unique patients after deduplication:', num_unique_patients)"}
